name: Chaaye Khana
tagline: Chaaye Khana, all day — a place to sit down, relax and enjoy.
about: Chaaye Khana, Jhelum is a fine-dining tea house and kitchen on GT Road, near the PSO Riverside filling station in Jhelum Cantonment. It is built around specialty teas, all-day breakfast and a full kitchen — Pakistani, Chinese and Continental dishes, BBQ, pizzas, sandwiches, a bakery counter of cakes and desserts, and steaks. Guests come to play a round of chess or linger with friends over a pot of tea; seating runs both indoors and outdoors.
